table.note: The query keeps the ordinary clusters (type C) the catalogue's own rule gives to the Small Magellanic Cloud (23 h 40 min < RA < 1 h 20 min, Bica et al. 2008, Sect. 3) and writes the Cloud's distance, Graczyk et al.'s (2020) 62.44 kpc, into each row. No cluster's own distance is measured: every one sits at its Cloud's distance, so the Cloud's depth is not drawn.

meaning: Star clusters of the Small Magellanic Cloud from Bica et al.'s (2008) catalogue of extended objects: one dot per ordinary cluster at its catalogue sky position, at the Cloud's distance.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way open-cluster layer's blue-white and size.
